locked.title: ERP integration & data migration
locked.lede: If your company already runs an ERP, a POS app or spreadsheets, Satu Alur does not ask you to switch systems. Your existing data is connected, mapped, then moved in phases while both systems keep running.
locked.available: This feature is available for Enterprise-scale accounts.
locked.note: Want to see an example? Sign in with an Enterprise demo account (PT Arunika, PT Prima Fasilitas or PT Sehat Bersih Medika).

aiAccess.copyFailed: Could not copy automatically. Select the text and press Ctrl+C.
aiAccess.once: Copy it now. The token is shown only once and cannot be viewed again.
aiAccess.step2: Click Add custom connector and name it "Satu Alur".
aiAccess.step3: Paste the URL below, then Add. The URL already contains the token, so do not share it.
aiAccess.desktopHelp: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit Config), then reopen Claude Desktop. Requires Node.js.
aiAccess.try: Then ask, for example: "How far along is the PT Maju job?", "What is this month's profit?" or "Which invoices are unpaid?"
aiAccess.revokeConfirm: Any Claude using this token is disconnected immediately.
aiAccess.loginDesc: No token to copy: paste the server address, sign in to Satu Alur, then click Allow.
aiAccess.loginStep1: Open Settings → Connectors, then click Add custom connector.
aiAccess.loginStep2: Name it "Satu Alur", paste the address below, then Add.
aiAccess.loginStep3: Click Connect. Claude opens the Satu Alur sign-in page: sign in as usual, then click Allow.
aiAccess.ccLogin: Run this in a terminal, then type /mcp in Claude Code, choose satu-alur and choose Authenticate:
aiAccess.readOnly: Access is read-only: Claude cannot change or delete data.
aiAccess.mockNote: Local demo mode: connections and tokens here are simulated and cannot be used to connect Claude.
aiAccess.appsDesc: Claude apps you allowed by signing in. Disconnect the ones you no longer use.
aiAccess.appsEmpty: No connected apps yet. Follow the steps above to connect Claude.
aiAccess.warn: A token gives read access to all of your business data. Keep it like a password, and revoke tokens that leak or are no longer used.
aiAccess.tokenNamePh: Example: Claude on the office laptop
aiAccess.tokenNameHint: So you can recognise this token later.
aiAccess.createDesc: For apps that do not support sign-in yet. Use one token per device or app so each can be revoked on its own.
aiAccess.demoNote: Demo accounts cannot be connected to Claude. Sign in with your own business account to connect Claude.
aiAccess.full: You already have {max} active tokens. Revoke one to create a new one.
aiAccess.lead: Connect Claude (claude.ai, Claude Desktop or Claude Code) to this account over MCP. Claude can answer questions about jobs, customer progress, finances and invoices.
